result.brief: 提出 ImagiRep 基准与 GEARS 测试时自适应表征选择策略，比较 RGB 与深度、全景、俯视几何等表征对空间想象推理的影响，表明仅生成 RGB 视图不足以支撑对未见状态的推理。
result.reason: Benchmark and method on which representations of imagined states (RGB vs depth, panorama, top-down) best support spatial reasoning in visual world models; directly about representation choice.
